source: 803 Transmitting Information
target: 803 Traditio Notitiae

source: Similar experiences were not new to Lumian; he had felt this way before.
target: Experientiae similes Lumiano non erant novae; talem sensum antea experitus erat.

source: Whenever Franca prayed to the Primordial Demoness figurine made of bone, Lumian would sometimes be nearby.
target: Quoties Franca ad effigiem ex ossibus factam Demonissae Primordialis orabat, aliquando Lumian prope aderat.

source: Even through doors and walls, through the wall of spirituality, he couldn’t help but feel sensations.
target: Etiam per ianuas et muros, per murum spiritualitatis, haud potuit quin sensus sentiret.

source: Is Julie praying to the Primordial Demoness figurine?
target: Num Julie ad effigiem Demonissae Primordialis orat?

source: Lumian, still with his eyes closed, made a guess about the current situation.
target: Lumian, adhuc oculos clausos tenens, de praesentibus rebus coniecturam fecit.

source: It wasn’t necessarily due to Julie’s extreme piety; it was a daily ritual for members of the Demoness Sect.
target: Id non necessario ex extrema pietate Julie proveniebat; sed erat ritu quotidiano membris Sectae Demonissae.

source: Even a believer of Mr. Fool, like Franca, had to do it regularly.
target: Etiam cultor Domini Stulti, ut Franca, id regulariter facere debebat.

source: Before long, the amorous energy in the air dissipated, and Lumian’s state returned to normal.
target: Mox, amorosa vis in aere dissipata est, et status Lumiani ad solitum rediit.

source: Suddenly, he remembered something: Where did Julie get a Primordial Demoness figurine?
target: Subito, aliquid meminit: ubi Julie effigiem Demonissae Primordialis obtinuit?

source: During the exile to Morora, Lumian noticed that neither Lez nor Julie seemed to carry personal belongings.
target: In exsilio in Morora, Lumian animadvertit neque Lez neque Julie bona sua ferre.

source: This meant that, except for Lumian, who had special treatment and wasn’t searched, all other exiles were handled by the standard procedure.
target: Hoc significabat, nisi Lumian, qui curam specialem habebat et non explorabatur, omnes reliquos exsules rite tractari.

source: So, Julie shouldn’t have a standard-issue figurine from the Demoness sect.
target: Ergo, Julie non debet habere effigiem consuetam ex Secta Demonissae.

source: Even if she wanted to make one herself, she would need to buy materials and set up a ritual, and Lumian’s tracking today showed she hadn’t done any preparations.
target: Etiam si ipsa eam fabricare vellet, materias emere atque ritum instituere oporteret, et indagatio hodierna Lumiani ostendit eam nullas praeparationes fecisse.

source: So, where did her Primordial Demoness figurine come from?
target: Ergo, unde orta est eius effigies Demonissae Primordialis?

source: Or did she directly use the language that can invoke natural forces to recite the Primordial Demoness’s honorific name?
target: An ipsa directe usuit linguam, quae potest vires naturales evocare, ad recitandum nomen honorificum Demonissae Primordialis?

source: But if that were the case, the influence of the power overflow on me would be too weak.
target: Sed, si ita esset, vis effusae potentiae in me nimis debilis foret.

source: Even if it was not as strong as the residual divine power Franca experienced, it shouldn’t be just a bit of restlessness… Lumian became extremely alert.
target: Etiam si non tam fortis quam potestas divina residua, quam Franca experita erat, non debebat esse tantum parva inquietudo… Lumian valde vigilans factus est.

source: He quickly had a hypothesis.
target: Celeriter hypothesim excogitavit.

source: Celeste had visited!
target: Celeste adfuit!

source: It must have been this Demoness, who had become an experimental subject, who gave Julie the Primordial Demoness figurine or something similar!
target: Fieri debuit hanc Demonessam, quae facta est subiecta experimentalis, Julie effigiem Demonissae Primordialis vel aliquid simile dedit!

source: Why didn’t I notice?
target: Cur non animadverti?

source: II was monitoring the room Julie was in all along…
target: Ego totum tempus conclave, in qua Julie erat, observabam.

source: With that thought, Lumian suddenly sat up and looked at the full-length mirror in his bedroom.
target: Hoc cogitato, Lumian subito consedit et speculum totum in cubiculo suo aspexit.

source: Yes!
target: Sic!

source: Celeste must have come through the mirror world!
target: Celeste certe per mundum specularum accessit!

source: She must have communicated with Julie through the mirror, which is why I didn’t detect anything unusual until Julie started praying!
target: Illam oportuit per speculum cum Julie communicavisse, ideo nihil inusitatum animadverti, donec Julie orare coepit!

source: It’s normal for the Demoness Sect to have items like the Mirror Cufflink!
target: Consuetum est in Secta Demonissae res tales habere, ut Fibula Specularis!

source: Silently, Lumian got out of bed and walked to the full-length mirror in his room.
target: Silentio, Lumian ex lecto exiit et ad speculum totum in cella sua accessit.

source: He felt it was time to use the Mirror Cufflink.
target: Sensit tempus esse ut Fibulam Specularis uteretur.

source: He put on the glass-like cufflink and pressed his hand against the mirror surface.
target: Indutus fibulam specularis, quae similis vitreo erat, manum contra superficiem speculi premuit.

source: The button-like accessory lit up with a faint glow, and Lumian’s figure immediately penetrated the mirror’s surface, entering the deep, dark mirror world.
target: Accessorium instar globuli leviter fulsit, et figura Lumiani statim superficiem speculi penetravit, ingrediens in profundum et obscurum mundum specularum.

source: Before the dark, web-like tunnels spread out before him, Lumian clearly sensed the three mirror imprints he had left in the outside world and the few he had set up in Julie’s and Lez’s rooms.
target: Antequam cuniculi tenebrosi, quasi retia, ante eum se pandissent, Lumian perspicue sensit tres impressiones speculi quas in mundo externo reliquerat et pauca quas in cellis Julie et Lez instituerat.

source: He didn’t rush to the mirror in Julie’s room.
target: Non festinavit ad speculum in cella Julie.

source: Instead, he took out an unfinished letter from the Traveler’s Bag.
target: Pro eo, litteram imperfectam e sacculo Viatoris extraxit.

source: It was a letter to Franca, Jenna, and Anthony.
target: Erat epistula ad Francam, Jennam et Anthonym.

source: Lumian then activated the black mark on his right shoulder, attempting to teleport to the full-length mirror in Franca and Jenna’s apartment.
target: Tum Lumian notam nigram in dextro humero excitavit, conatus transire se ad speculum totum in domo Francae et Jennae.

source: It felt distant and had an invisible barrier.
target: Videbatur remotum esse et habebat claustrum invisibile.

source: Even if he penetrated the barrier, there was a vast, silent void of darkness that Lumian instinctively believed contained indescribable danger and terror.
target: Etiam si claustrum penetravisset, illic erat immensa et silens vacuum obscuritatis, quod Lumian instinctu credebat inenarrabilem periculum et terrorem contineri.

source: Does this represent that special mirror world?
target: Num hoc repraesentat illum specialem mundum specularum?

source: To leave Morora and return to the outside world, I must pass through it?
target: Ut Mororam relinquam et ad mundum externum redeam, per ipsum transeundum mihi est?

source: Even Angels would find it dangerous…
target: Etiam Angeli id periculosum esse putarent…

source: With these thoughts, Lumian stretched out his right hand, holding the letter, using the already activated Mirror Cufflink to give the paper a reflective, glass-like hue, and sent it out.
target: His cogitationibus, Lumian dextram manum protulit, epistulam tenens, Fibulam Specularis iam activatam adhibens, ut chartae speciem vitreae reflexivae conferret, eam misit.

source: The light stuck to the invisible barrier’s surface, slowly permeating it, falling into the dead silence, and heading toward the distant target mirror.
target: Lux ad superficiem claustri invisibilis adhaesit, eam lente permeans, in silentium mortuum incidens, et versus speculum propositum remotum se dirigebat.

source: It works… Lumian breathed a sigh of relief and used the contracted ability of Spirit World Traversal to shift to the mirror in Julie’s room.
target: Operatur… Lumian suspirum levationis exhalavit et facultatem contractam Transitus Spiritus Mundi adhibuit, ut se in speculum cellae Julie moveret.

source: The mirror was pitch black with no traces left.
target: Speculum prorsus atrum erat, nullis vestigiis relicto.

source: Lumian sniffed slightly, catching a lingering scent.
target: Lumian leviter olfactus est, odorum perseverantem capiens.

source: It smelled like a human hormone, coupled with the influence of mystical power, faintly sweet, amorous, and warm.
target: Odores erant ut hormonum humanum, iunctum cum influxu potentiae mysticae, leniter dulces, amorosi et calidi.

source: Not Julie’s scent… Lumian nodded slightly. Celeste indeed visited.
target: Non odor Julie erat… Lumian leviter annuit. Revera, Celeste adfuit!

source: Now the question was, did Celeste use an item to traverse the mirror world and reach Julie’s room, an item that escaped the Church of Knowledge’s search, or did she use the special connection of the mirror world to send it through a ritual?
target: Nunc quaestio erat: utrum Celeste rem ad transgrediendum mundum specularum et pervenire ad cellam Julie usus sit—rem quae investigationi Ecclesiae Cognitionis evaserat—aut an nexum speciale mundi specularis per ritum adhibuerit ad eam mitterendam?

source: Or, did she conduct a ritual to ask the Primordial Demoness for it?
target: An potius ritum egit ut eam a Demonissa Primordiali peteret?

source: Or is she no longer the original Celeste but her corresponding special Mirror Person?
target: An iam non est Celeste originalis, sed persona specularis specialis ei correspondens?

source: This could explain why she retained some self-awareness after becoming an experimental subject, but it’s not the only explanation…
target: Hoc explicare posset cur aliquam sui conscientiam postquam subiecta experimentali facta sit retinuerit, sed non sola explanatio id est.

source: Lumian, an experienced handler of mystical events with much knowledge, naturally linked it to the special Mirror People.
target: Lumian, peritus in rebus mysticis et multa scientia instructus, id naturaliter ad speciales Personae Speculares coniunxit.

source: He didn’t peek into Julie’s current situation through the mirror, fearing Celeste had given Julie some mirror-related items, making her more sensitive to the gaze from the mirror.
target: Non perspexit in condicionem praesentem Julie per speculum, metuens Celeste Julie aliquas res speculis pertinentes dederit, quae eam sensibiliora ad aspectum speculi fecerint.

source: Moreover, Julie had just finished praying, and the Primordial Demoness figurine’s residual effects lingered.
target: Praeterea, Julie modo orationem finivit, et reliquae effectuum effigiei Demonissae Primordialis manebant.

source: Lumian didn’t know if this would affect his spying.
target: Lumian nesciebat num hoc eius speculandi laborem afficere posset.

source: Of course, he could roughly guess what Julie was doing.
target: Certe, paene coniectare poterat quid Julie faceret.

source: Because he could hear Julie’s suppressed, soft moans through the mirror.
target: Nam per speculum audire poterat voces Julie repressas et suaves gemitus.

source: Lovers reunited, getting what they wanted, relaxing and celebrating.
target: Amantes reïuniti, id quod desideraverunt accipiens, se relaxantes et celebrantes.

source: Yes, and the sensations brought by praying to the Primordial Demoness figurine.
target: Ita, et sensus, quos oratione ad effigiem Demonissae Primordialis attulit.

source: She hasn’t gone out to add to her collection, which is already quite restrained.
target: Non egreditur ut collectionem suam augeat, quae iam satis temperata est.

source: Lumian silently chuckled.
target: Lumian tacite subridens.

source: He teleported back to his bedroom mirror, stepped out of the glass surface, and lay back on the bed.
target: Se translocavit ad speculum in cubiculo suo, ex superficie vitrea exivit, et in lecto recubavit.

source: Trier.
target: Trier.

source: Lonely, empty, cold… Franca, used to go early to bed and early to rise, sighed, lying in bed, unable to sleep.
target: Solitaria, vacua, frigida… Franca, quae solebat mane cubitum ire et mane surgere, suspiravit, in lecto iacens, dormitum non posse.

source: She felt she needed a few more days to adapt.
target: Sentiabat se paucos dies amplius ad se accommodandum egere.

source: At this moment, she sensed something, sat up, walked out of the room, and went to the living room.
target: In hoc momento, aliquid sensit, consedit, conclave exiit, et ad atrium processit.

source: She looked at the full-length mirror in the living room and saw a water-like light wave on the glass surface, reflecting a neatly folded letter.
target: Aspiciebat speculum totum in atrio et vidit undam lucis instar aquae super superficie speculi, quae epistulam diligenter plicatam reflectebat.

source: Is it from Lumian or the Demoness of Black?
target: Num ea a Lumiano aut a Demonissa Nigra est?

source: Franca walked over and pressed her hand against the mirror’s surface.
target: Franca accessit et manum contra superficiem speculi premuit.

source: Her right hand felt slightly cold, as if penetrating a lake mixed with ice, touching the now ethereal, intangible paper.
target: Manus dextra eius leviter frigida sensa est, quasi lacum glaciei mixtum penetrare, tangens chartam nunc aetheream et intangibilem.

source: The paper quickly “dispersed,” forming lines of Intisian words on the mirror surface: “I have arrived in Morora…”
target: Charta celeriter “dispersa” est, lineas verborum Intisianorum in superficie speculi formans: “Ad Mororam perveni…”

source: Lumian briefly described his experiences and the results of the experiment but didn’t mention the specific situation in Morora.
target: Lumian breviter suas experientias et eventus experimenti narravit, sed rem specificam in Morora non contulit.

source: It was a kind of corruption!
target: Fuit genus corruptionis!

source: A corruption Franca and the others might not withstand!
target: Corruptio, quam Franca et ceteri fortasse non sustinere possent!

source: At the end of the letter, Lumian reminded: “I’ve already told my messenger and Madame Hela that if anyone writes to me but can’t find me, they should send it to you to handle. Yes, I’m talking about you, Franca. Now you temporarily have a messenger.”
target: In fine epistulae, Lumian recordatus est: “Iam nuntio meo et Domina Hela certiorem feci, quod, si quis mihi scribat sed me invenire nequit, id ad te transferendum sit. Ita, de te loquor, Franca. Nunc tibi nuntius ad tempus habes.”

source: Dammit, he still has to mock me in the end! Franca cursed in a mix of anger and amusement, grinding her teeth.
target: Di immortales, adhuc me in fine deridere debet! Franca, ira et delectatione simul, dentes stridens, maledixit!

source: She thought for a moment and began writing a reply:
target: Paulisper cogitavit et responsum scribere coepit:

source: Nothing much to say, just a reminder: The Demoness of Black told me that Demonesses with color titles occasionally receive revelations from the Primordial One and have strong autonomy.
target: Parum est quid dicere, tantum admonitio: Demonissa Nigra mihi dixit Demonissas cum titulis coloratis, interdum revelationes ab Uno Primordiali accipere et autonomiam validam habere.

source: If they are like this, won’t the Demonesses of Affliction sent to Morora for important tasks also receive revelations, or even some divine power from the figurine?
target: Si ita sunt, num Demonissae Afflictionis, ad Mororam pro rebus gravibus missae, non etiam revelationes accipient, aut etiam aliquam potentiam divinam ex effigie?

source: You should take this issue seriously.
target: Hoc negotium serio accipere debes.

source: Also, it’s time to test your Ascetic endurance.
target: Praeterea, tempus est tolerantiam asceticam tuam probare.

source: If you get bewitched and lose your manhood, even if it grows back every morning, I’ll laugh at you for the rest of your life.
target: Si incantaris et virilitatem amittas, etiam si omni mane regeneretur, totam vitam tuam ridebo.

source: After finishing, Franca folded the paper and took out a rectangular amulet from the Traveler’s Bag that looked like it was made of ice.
target: Postquam finivit, Franca chartam plicavit et ex sacculo Viatoris amuletum rectangulare extraxit, quod, quasi ex glacie factum, videbatur.

source: The amulet was entirely transparent, with patterns and motifs like bubbles inside, flowing and gathering continuously.
target: Amuletum erat omnino transparens, cum figuris et ornamentis instar bullarum interioribus, fluentibus et congregantibus continuo.

source: It was the Ice Amulet given to Franca by the Demoness of Black, allowing seven traversals through the mirror world or fourteen transmissions of information.
target: Hoc erat Amuletum Glaciale, a Demonissa Nigra Francae datum, quod septem transitus per mundum specularum aut quattuordecim transmissiones notitiae concedebat.

source: Franca put on the amulet, held the letter, and returned to the full-length mirror.
target: Franca amuletum induit, epistulam tenuit, et ad speculum totum rediit.

source: With a flash of cold light, she pressed the letter into the mirror surface, letting it fall toward the place the previous message came from.
target: Cum fulgore frigido, epistulam in superficiem speculi premuit, sinens eam cadere versus locum unde prior nuntius venit.

source: Morora.
target: Morora.

source: After reading the letter on the mirror’s surface, Lumian lay back on the bed again.
target: Postquam epistulam in superficie speculi legit, Lumian iterum in lecto recubavit.

source: He anticipated possible surprises.
target: Praevidit eventus inopinatos.

source: Like Wanak, the owner of Dades Agricultural Company, coming to kill him at night.
target: Sicut Wanak, dominus Societatis Agricolae Dades, qui nocte ad eum occidendum veniret.

source: This most dangerous criminal in Morora should soon figure out who the exile he confronted in the afternoon was.
target: Hic periculosissimus in Morora mox intellegere debet quis fuerit exsul quem postmeridie occurrisset.

source: He must already know that Lumian killed the Carnivore bar owner and took over the place.
target: Iamdudum scire debet quod Lumian dominum tabernae Carnivoris interfecit et locum obtinuit.

source: Given his attitude, he couldn’t wait to kill Lumian on the spot.
target: Propter eius indolem, non poterat exspectare ut Lumian in loco occideretur.

source: Now, he hoped Wanak would come soon.
target: Nunc sperabat Wanak mox venire.

source: Then, he would teleport away, leaving Julie, the Demoness, for Wanak, letting them have an intense duel.
target: Tum se translocaret, relinquens Julie et Demonissam ad Wanak, sinens eos vehementer certare.

source: That way, he could see what cards Julie had, what items she got from Celeste, and whether Wanak could further use the power of 0-01.
target: Ita videret quae chartae Julie haberet, quae res a Celeste acceperit, et num Wanak ulterius potentiam 0-01 adhibere posset.

source: To Lumian’s disappointment, Wanak didn’t show up all night.
target: Ad delusionem Lumiani, Wanak tota nocte non apparuit.

source: Is there a need to be this cautious? Just come straight here…
target: Num ita cautus esse necesse est? Nunc, directe huc venias…

source: Lumian muttered, getting out of bed and heading downstairs.
target: Lumian ex lecto exiens et deorsum descendens, murmuratione dixit.

source: Chef Lez was already up, preparing breakfast with the kitchen ingredients.
target: Cocus Lez iam surrexit, prandium cum rebus culinae praeparans.

source: “We can resume operations by noon today,” Lez said, glancing at Lumian.
target: “Operatiōnibus ad meridiem hodie resumere possumus,” inquit Lez, Lumian intuens.

source: “But we don’t have any beef, lamb, or pork in stock.”
target: “Sed nullum bubulum, agnum, aut porcinum in copia habemus.”

source: “I’ll give you some startup funds,” Lumian replied, just about to leave the kitchen when he suddenly heard Julie’s footsteps coming down the stairs.
target: “Initium pecuniae tibi dabo,” respondit Lumian, vix ex culina discedens, cum subito audivit vestigia pedum Julie de scalis descendere.

source: An idea crossed his mind, and he casually said to Lez, "By the way, let me tell you about a few people you need to be cautious of. Whatever you do, don’t provoke them.
target: Idea illi occurrit, et ad Lez leviter dixit: “Interim, sinas me narrare de paucis hominibus quibus caveas. Quidquid facias, eos ne provoces.”

source: “First, there’s Wanak, the owner of Dades Agricultural Company…”
target: “Primum, est Wanak, dominus Societatis Agricolae Dades…”

source: Lumian relayed all of Gusain’s warnings to Lez and then added, "And another one, named Albus Medici…"
target: Lumian omnes monitiones Gusain ad Lez enarravit, deinde addidit: “Et alter, nomine Albus Medici…”

source: As soon as he mentioned the name, Lumian heard Julie’s footsteps pause momentarily.
target: Statim, cum nomen illud dixisset, Lumian audivit vestigia pedum Julie paulisper subsistere.
